title: Sergio Aragones
description:
"I loved STAR WARS from day one," admits Sergio Aragones. "And like any work of that magnitude, it was open for satire. I enjoyed doing a 'MAD look at STAR WARS' for MAD magazine...and I was very happy to participate in this collection." Born 1937 in Spain, Aragones came to America in 1962 and began his creative alliance with the MAD publishers. A good deal of work for DC followed, including BAT LASH, PLOP!, ANGEL AND THE APE and HOUSE OF MYSTERY. In 1982 he created "Groo the Wanderer" (DESTROYER DUCK, Eclipse), which was picked up by Pacific and later Epic, where it continues. Recent works include BELL AND BUZZ and FIREHOUSE FIVE from Malibu.
